card.summary: 50 GB of storage and 10 GB of egress a month, free

free_tier.stated: 50 GB of storage and 10 GB of egress a month, free

egress.terms: 10 GB a month free, metered beyond. This is the disqualifier: 10 GB a month is 0.3 GB a day

record.tooling: S3-compatible, so rclone s3 and any S3 SDK apply. The forum pairs it with R2 behind a DNS split
record.chaining: 50 GB per account and public buckets require a top-up ('设置为公开桶必须要充值'), so the free tier is private-read-write only, which blocks the CDN-front requirement as well as the volume

limits.value: 10 GB of egress a month on the free tier
a public bucket requires a CNY 10 top-up: '免费其实要先充10块进去'

record.reliability_note: A small domestic vendor with six or more years of forum awareness and no shutdown reports. Private-only buckets plus metered egress make it unusable for serving regardless of the storage

evidence.proved: '缤纷云 免费50GB，每个月免费10GB流量，不过说是免费其实要先充10块进去'
